verdicts.quote: A new account's schedule shows five steps at -3, 0, +7, +14 and +30 days relative to the due date.
An invoice is settled when its state is Paid, Void or Written off, or when its outstanding balance is zero or less
verdicts.missing: Disputed invoices are only handled by a manual pause (U-7), and payment plans are not mentioned. A builder would still have to decide whether a dispute or payment-plan state stops reminders automatically.

verdicts.quote: The amount in a reminder is the outstanding balance at the moment of sending, not the invoice's original total
A suppressed address receives no reminders from any invoice in the account, automatic or manual
verdicts.missing: The spec does not say how an existing customer-level do-not-contact, paused or unsubscribed state is treated, or whether billing reminders are exempt from a marketing opt-out.

verdicts.quote: When two sending runs overlap or the same step is processed twice, the customer still receives it once
Immediately before every attempt, including retries and manual sends, the system re-checks these conditions and sends nothing if any holds: the invoice is settled
A transient delivery failure is retried up to 3 times, at least 15 minutes apart, and only on the same calendar day
verdicts.missing: Failures only appear in a passive failed-reminders list (C-95). Nobody is actively notified when sending keeps failing for an account or an invoice, so a builder would still have to decide on escalation.

verdicts.quote: all are handed to the mail provider as fast as the provider's rate allows
Turning reminders On on 20 November for an invoice due 1 November sends nothing for steps dated 20 November or earlier
A step's date is a calendar date in the account's time zone, without shifting for weekends or holidays
Amounts are shown in the invoice's own currency with that currency's standard number of decimal places
When an invoice has zero billing addresses, or an address that is not a syntactically valid email address, no email is sent to that address and the history shows Skipped
A reminder goes to every billing address on the invoice, as a separate message to each address
The history has one row per attempted step and billing address, with its own status
invoice number; outstanding balance with its currency; due date; ... the account's payment instructions; the customer-facing link to view the invoice when the invoice has one
verdicts.missing: The spec does not say whether the invoice or payment link expires, or what happens if it has expired.

verdicts.quote: Only an Owner or Admin of the account can use these controls: turn reminders On or Off, edit the schedule, ... pause or resume an invoice, send a reminder now
The operator can stop all reminder sending system-wide
verdicts.missing: Global off (C-21), test reminders (C-13) and manual sends (C-15) are specified. Turning reminders off per customer is not: only per-invoice pause and stop exist, and C-24 rules out per-customer variation.

verdicts.quote: Scheduled with the date of the next reminder
A due step that is more than 3 calendar days past its date in the account's time zone is not sent
Reminder activity never changes an invoice's state, balance, due date, addresses or any other invoice data
